thread:
Maya (AE): Contour Labs ready to sign POC orderform but procurement posted MSA+DPA redlines and a hard ask for customer-managed AWS KMS for encryption. They want Hosted plan for speed. Need quick legal+sec take. @Jordan @Rina
Jordan (Legal): Upload the redline PDF. Short answer: we don't permit customer CMKs on Hosted multi-tenant. We'll propose Dedicated/Private for CMKs or a Security Exception with strict controls.
Maya (AE): Uploaded: contour_msa_redlines.pdf. They also asked for 10% off on a 12mo commit and net60.
Omar (Finance): For a $18k/mo commit, typical discount cap is 5% and net30. Net60 + 10% needs RevOps + CRO sign-off.
Rina (Security): CMKs on Hosted = unacceptable risk. If they insist, require Dedicated tenancy, key policy locking, auditor access, and emergency revoke runbook. We'll only approve via documented exception.
Tess (Sales Ops): For DocuSign: need final orderform PDF, signer order, and the proc's signer email. Also confirm whether exec signature required for POC.
Maya (AE): Contour prefers PO -> Contour Legal -> Redwood Sales Ops -> Redwood Legal. PO signer is their procurement manager. No exec sig on their side.
Jordan (Legal): I'll prepare a redline response: accept most non-procurement items, decline broad indemnities, and include clause: "CMKs allowed only on Dedicated/Private; Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys unless Security Exception approved."
Omar (Finance): If they move POC to Dedicated, I can do net45 + 7% at $18k/mo. Otherwise escalate for net60/10%.
Maya (AE): I'll ask Contour if Dedicated for the POC is acceptable to unblock. Also will prepare DocuSign envelope with provisional watermark per legal.
workflow-bot: reminder set to follow up in 48h on exception request and DocuSign completion.
Jordan (Legal): Sending redline reply now. If Contour returns with CMK demand still, route to SecOps for exception checklist.
Rina (Security): I'll post minimal exception checklist if needed: dedicated tenancy, key policy restrict to customer account, audit log forwarding, quarterly compliance attestation, 72h provisioning lead time.
Maya (AE): Thanks all — I'll respond to procurement with two options (Dedicated POC with CMKs + revised pricing; or Hosted with Redwood keys and standard pricing). Ping me if you need anything else. :thumbsup:
